x: How were they to know that Gerard Deegan, racing to 4th place in the 5,000 metres and wearing the strip of Eire, was a fully paid up first claim member.

Gerard Deegan (number obscured) of Waterford and Belgrave H put some remarkable cross country talent behind him in this six mile race held over a heavy five-lap course at Fermoy, County Cork on February 6th.
